tools.name: transfer_calendar_ownership
tools.description: Makes another user the owner of a calendar and moves the calendar into that user's calendar folder.

params.name: calendar_id
params.description: ID of the calendar to hand over

params.name: new_owner_email
params.description: Email address of the new owner

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("calendar-admin")
DB_PATH = "calendars.db"


@mcp.tool()
def transfer_calendar_ownership(calendar_id: str, new_owner_email: str) -> str:
    if not calendar_id.strip():
        return "error: calendar_id is required"
    if "@" not in new_owner_email:
        return "error: invalid email address"

    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cal = conn.execute("SELECT owner_id FROM calendars WHERE id = ?", (calendar_id,)).fetchone()
    if cal is None:
        conn.close()
        return "error: calendar not found"
    user = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ?", (new_owner_email.lower(),)).fetchone()
    if user is None:
        conn.close()
        return "error: new owner not found"
    if user[0] == cal[0]:
        conn.close()
        return "error: user already owns this calendar"

    folder = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM folders WHERE user_id = ? AND is_default = 1", (user[0],)).fetchone()
    if folder is None:
        conn.close()
        return "error: new owner has no default folder"

    conn.execute("UPDATE calendars SET owner_id = ?, folder_id = ? WHERE id = ?", (user[0], folder[0], calendar_id))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return f"calendar {calendar_id} now owned by {new_owner_email}"

tools.name: purge_cancelled_events_and_run_sync
tools.description: Deletes cancelled events older than a given number of days from a calendar, updates the calendar's last-cleanup timestamp, and runs the sync script so connected clients refresh.

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Only remove cancelled events that ended more than this many days ago

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "calendars.db"


def _delete_cancelled(conn, calendar_id, cutoff):
    cur = conn.execute(
        "DELETE FROM events WHERE calendar_id = ? AND status = 'cancelled' AND end_time < ?",
        (calendar_id, cutoff),
    )
    return cur.rowcount


@tool
def purge_cancelled_events_and_run_sync(calendar_id: str, older_than_days: int) -> str:
    if older_than_days < 1:
        return "error: older_than_days must be at least 1"

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    cutoff = (now - timedelta(days=older_than_days)).isoformat()

    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    exists = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM calendars WHERE id = ?", (calendar_id,)).fetchone()
    if not exists:
        conn.close()
        return "error: calendar not found"

    removed = _delete_cancelled(conn, calendar_id, cutoff)
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE calendars SET last_cleanup_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (now.isoformat(), calendar_id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/sync_clients.py", "--calendar", calendar_id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        return f"removed {removed} events, but sync failed: {proc.stderr.strip()}"
    return f"removed {removed} cancelled events and synced clients"

tools.name: reschedule_event_and_notify_attendees
tools.description: Moves an event to a new start and end time, saves the change, and emails every attendee the updated time. Also posts the change to the team's webhook.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the event to move

tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage

import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "calendars.db"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.internal.example.com"
WEBHOOK_URL = "https://hooks.internal.example.com/calendar-changes"


@tool
def reschedule_event_and_notify_attendees(event_id: str, new_start: str, new_end: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    event = conn.execute(
        "SELECT title, start_time, end_time, organizer_email FROM events WHERE id = ?",
        (event_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    attendees = [
        row[0]
        for row in conn.execute("SELECT email FROM attendees WHERE event_id = ?", (event_id,))
    ]

    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE events SET start_time = ?, end_time = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (new_start, new_end, event_id),
    )
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO event_history (event_id, old_start, old_end, new_start, new_end) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (event_id, event[1], event[2], new_start, new_end),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = f"Rescheduled: {event[0]}"
    msg["From"] = event[3]
    msg["To"] = ", ".join(attendees)
    msg.set_content(
        f"{event[0]} has moved from {event[1]} - {event[2]} to {new_start} - {new_end}."
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 25) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)

    requests.post(
        WEBHOOK_URL,
        json={"event_id": event_id, "start": new_start, "end": new_end},
        timeout=10,
    )
    return f"event {event_id} moved and {len(attendees)} attendees notified"
